readme.note: Response packet demo. Every connector supports a backward-flowing 'response' alongside its forward value. Requester sends a fresh request each tick and logs whatever comes back via ctx.responses. Responder echoes what it receives and sends a response the first time it sees a new value (tracking state.lastAcked so it doesn't re-react to the same input twice — good practice, even though the engine itself never resends a response you don't explicitly set again). Step Simulation a few times and watch the Message Log: each response is delivered exactly once, one tick after it was set.

parts.label: Requester
parts.description: Sends a new request every tick; reads Responder's ack back via ctx.responses. fromLabel identifies who responded, so this script never hardcodes Responder's identity.

parts.label: Responder
parts.description: Echoes whatever it receives on ctx.inputs, and sends a `response` back the first time it sees a given value — the response broadcasts to every node that sent this part forward data (just Requester here), delivered one tick later.
